## Security & Responsible AI (RAI) Checklist
- [ ] Maken sure no secrets, tokens, or credentials are committed.
- [ ] Data Loss Prevention (DLP) boundaries are respected.
- [ ] Any AI prompt changes should conform to fairness, accuracy, and accountability standards.
- [ ] Solution/code changes tested in the target development environment.
- [ ] Make sure every PR is read and reviewed before changes can be made, whether the code was by a human or AI.
